basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and virtual item trader, specializing in Royale High and various other virtual worlds. Based in Toronto, Canada, and usually active during late evenings and weekends. Works as a freelance graphic designer, which affords a flexible schedule. Enjoys watching anime and exploring new subreddits in his free time. Single and a proud cat parent to two adorable felines.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: This user has developed a deep knowledge of virtual item trading through years of active participation in gaming communities. Initially started trading on a small scale but quickly expanded expertise through self-teaching and interacting with experienced traders. Often consults various resources online to stay updated with market trends.
